text: 你拖着疲惫的双腿，跟猿人爬上悬崖。你坐在那里等了几个小时，忽然意识到自己已经离开失落山谷，附近森林正是先前穿越的大森林。你敢不敢逃跑？

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 386
text: With weary legs, you accompany the ape-men to the top of the cliff. You sit waiting for several hours. It occurs to you that you have climbed out of the lost valley and that the forest nearby is part of the Big Woods that you crossed before. Do you dare try to escape?
